Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

transcript.en: Hello, Linda speaking.
transcript.zh: 你好，我是琳达。

transcript.en: Oh hi, Linda. This is Matt Brooks.
transcript.zh: 哦,嗨,琳达。这是马特·布鲁克斯。

transcript.en: Alex White gave me your number.
transcript.zh: 亚历克斯·怀特给了我你的电话号码。

transcript.en: He said you’d be able to give me some advice about moving to Banford.
transcript.zh: 他说你可以给我一些关于搬到班福德的建议。

transcript.en: Yes, Alex did mention you. How can I help?
transcript.zh: 是的，亚历克斯提到过你。我能帮什么忙吗?

transcript.en: Well, first of all - which area to live in?
transcript.zh: 嗯，好的。首先，住在哪个地区呢?

transcript.en: Well. I live in Dalton, which is a really nice suburb - not too expensive, and there’s a nice park.
transcript.zh: 好。我住在道尔顿，这是一个很好的郊区——不太贵，而且有一个很好的公园。

transcript.en: Sounds good. Do you know how much it would be to rent a two bedroom flat there?
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。你知道在那里租一套两居室要多少钱吗?

transcript.en: Yeah, you should be able to get something reasonable for 850 pounds per month.
transcript.zh: 哦，是的，你应该可以以每月850英镑的合理价格租到房子，

transcript.en: That’s what people typically pay.
transcript.zh: 一般都是这个价格。

transcript.en: You certainly wouldn’t want to pay more than 900 pounds.
transcript.zh: 你肯定不会想租超过900英镑的房子，

transcript.en: That doesn’t include bills or anything.
transcript.zh: 而且还不包括账单或其它东西。

transcript.en: No. That sounds alright I’ll definitely have a look there.
transcript.zh: 是的，听起来不错，我一定会去看看的。

transcript.en: Are the transport links easy from where you live?
transcript.zh: 你住的地方交通方便吗?

transcript.en: Well, I’m very lucky.
transcript.zh: 嗯,我很幸运。

transcript.en: I work in the city centre so I don’t have to use public transport. I go by bike.
transcript.zh: 我在市中心工作，所以我不用乘坐公共交通工具。我骑自行车。

transcript.en: Oh, I wish I could do that. Is it safe to cycle around the city?
transcript.zh: 哦，我希望我也是这样，在城里骑自行车安全吗?

transcript.en: Yes, it’s fine. And it keeps me fit.
transcript.zh: 是的,很安全。骑行让我保持健康。

transcript.en: Anyway, driving to work in the city centre would be a nightmare because there’s hardly any parking.
transcript.zh: 无论如何，开车去市中心上班将是一场噩梦，

transcript.en: And the traffic during the rush hour can be bad.
transcript.zh: 高峰时段的交通也很糟糕。

transcript.en: I’d be working from home but I’d have to go to London one or two days a week.
transcript.zh: 我在家工作，但我每周得去伦敦一、两天。

transcript.en: Oh, that’s perfect. Getting to London is no problem.
transcript.zh: 哦，那很好呀。去伦敦没有问题。

transcript.en: There’s a fast train every 30 minutes which only takes 45 minutes.
transcript.zh: 每30分钟有一班快车，只要45分钟。

transcript.en: That’s good.
transcript.zh: 这就好。

transcript.en: Yeah, the train service isn’t bad during the week.
transcript.zh: 工作日的火车服务并不差，

transcript.en: And they run quite late at night It’s weekends that are a problem.
transcript.zh: 而且它们会开很晚，只是周末会有问题。

transcript.en: They’re always doing engineering work and you have to take a bus to Hadham and pick up the train there, which is really slow.
transcript.zh: 周末总是会有工程问题，你必须坐公共汽车去哈德汉姆，从那里搭火车，那真的很慢。

transcript.en: But other than that, Banford’s a great place to live.I’ve never been happier
transcript.zh: 但除此之外，班福德是一个很好的居住地。我从来没有这么开心过。

transcript.en: There are some nice restaurants in the city centre and a brand new cinema which has only been open a couple of months.
transcript.zh: 市中心有几家不错的餐馆，还有一家新开了几个月的电影院。

transcript.en: There’s a good arts centre too.
transcript.zh: 也有一个很好的艺术中心。

transcript.en: Sounds like Banford’s got it all.
transcript.zh: 听起来班福德什么都有。

transcript.en: Yes! We’re really lucky.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们非常幸运，

transcript.en: There are lots of really good aspects to living here.
transcript.zh: 生活在这里真的好处多多。

transcript.en: The schools are good and the hospital here is one of the best in the country.
transcript.zh: 学校也不错，这里的医院是全国最好的医院之一。

transcript.en: Everyone I know who’s been there’s had a positive experience.
transcript.zh: 我认识的每个人都有过积极的经历。

transcript.en: Oh, I can give you the name of my dentist too in Bridge Street, if you’re interested.
transcript.zh: 哦，如果你感兴趣的话，我可以把布里奇街牙医的名字告诉你，

transcript.en: I’ve been going to him for years and I’ve never had any problems.
transcript.zh: 我去他那看牙已有好几年了，自此什么问题都没有发生过。

transcript.en: Oh ok, thanks!
transcript.zh: 哦，好的，谢谢！

transcript.en: I’ll find his number and send it to you.
transcript.zh: 我找到他的号码就发给你。

transcript.en: Thanks, that would be really helpful.
transcript.zh: 谢谢，那你真的帮了大忙了。

transcript.en: Are you planning to visit Banford soon?
transcript.zh: 你打算很快就来班福德吗?

transcript.en: Yes. My wife and I are both coming next week.
transcript.zh: 是的。我和我妻子下周就要去了。

transcript.en: We want to make some appointments with estate agents.
transcript.zh: 我们想和房地产经纪人约个时间见面。

transcript.en: I could meet you if you like and show you around.
transcript.zh: 如果你愿意，我可以见见你，然后带你去四处看看。

transcript.en: Are you sure? We’d really appreciate that
transcript.zh: 你确定吗？我们会感激不尽的。

transcript.en: Either a Tuesday or Thursday is good for me, after 5.30.
transcript.zh: 5点半以后，星期二或星期四对我来说都可以。

transcript.en: Thursday’s preferable - Tuesday I need to get home before 6 pm.
transcript.zh: 星期四比较好——星期二我需要在下午6点以前回到家。

transcript.en: OK. Great. Let me know which train you’re catching and I’ll meet you in the café outside.
transcript.zh: 好的，那太好了，告诉我你要乘坐哪趟车，我就在外面的咖啡馆等你，

transcript.en: You can’t miss it. It’s opposite the station and next to the museum.
transcript.zh: 你不会错过它的，它就在车站的对面，博物馆的旁边。

transcript.en: Brilliant. I'll text you next week then. Thanks so much for all the advice.
transcript.zh: 太棒了。那我下周给你发短信。谢谢你的建议。

transcript.en: No problem. I’ll see you next week.
transcript.zh: 好的，下周见。
